mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 3.7% over a 3-month window signals weakening labor market conditions, which triggers a shift toward risk-off sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 3.7% for 3 months, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals strong underlying demand momentum, which drives corporate earnings expectations and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS rise simultaneously (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 104.0 for two consecutive months indicates weakening supply-side capacity, which raises recession risks and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in CPIAUCSL above 295.0 within one month signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Fed to delay rate cuts and increasing real rates, which depresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative during CPIAUCSL spikes above 295.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in both GDP (GDPC1) and residential construction (HOUST) signals robust aggregate demand, which strengthens corporate revenue outlooks and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both GDPC1 and HOUST rise simultaneously (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 153,000 in a single month signals strong labor market health, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS exceeds 153,000 (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 1.5% and CPIAUCSL is above 295.0, the combination signals a restrictive monetary policy stance amid persistent inflation, which increases discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where both FEDFUNDS > 1.5% and CPIAUCSL > 295.0, or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
